example.title: Capacitor-buffered LED fade
example.question: How does stored capacitor charge change an LED pulse?
example.expected: C1 charges across D1 while the input is high; after the input falls, stored charge keeps LED current flowing briefly as voltage decays.
example.try: Compare input voltage, C1 voltage and D1 current. Change C1 from 100 µF to 220 µF and compare the falling-edge tail.
example.limitation: Ideal capacitor and generic red LED; source low discharges through R1 as well as D1. Brightness is illustrative; no physical LED rating, ESR or heating.
